{{Quote|Who doesn't love a good proteinloaf? You get three thick slices of succulent proteinloaf made using a tried-and-true recipe and covered in our unique brown dwarf gravy. (The gravy can also be used as an industrial-strength lubricant in a pinch, if you ever have the need.)|Dex's Diner on its home-style proteinloaf|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Brown dwarf gravy''' was a type of [[Gravy/Legends|gravy]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with a classification of [[Star/Legends|star]], the [[Brown dwarf/Legends|brown dwarf]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served home-style [[proteinloaf]] with its unique [[Color/Legends|brown]] dwarf [[Sauce/Legends|gravy]]. The diner's menu claimed that the gravy could also be used as an industrial&ndash;strength [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brown dwarf gravy was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
